newsitem.title: USA: NFL-GREEN BAY PACKERS' CHAMPIONSHIP HISTORY.
newsitem.headline: NFL-GREEN BAY PACKERS' CHAMPIONSHIP HISTORY.

text.p: The Green Bay Packers, who
won their first NFL title in 29 years by beating the New
England Patriots 35-21 Sunday, have won 12 championships, more
than any other team in National Football League history.
The Packers won their first three by league standing
(1929, 1930 and 1931) and nine since the league's playoff
system was established in 1933.
They are the only team NFL team to win three straight
titles, having done it twice (1929-31 and 1965-67).
The Packers won the first two Super Bowls over Kansas City
in 1967 and Oakland in 1968.
The Chicago Bears rank second with nine NFL titles,
followed by the New York Giants with six.
Green Bay's championship record:
League Standings
1929 -- Packers win NFL title with 12-0-1 record
1930 -- Packers win NFL title with 10-3-1 record
1931 -- Packers win NFL title with 12-2 record
NFL Championships
1936 -- Green Bay Packers 21, Boston Redskins 6, at New York
1938 -- New York Giants 23, Green Bay Packers 17, at New York
1939 -- Green Bay Packers 27, New York Giants 0, at Milwaukee
1944 -- Green Bay Packers 14, New York Giants 7, at New York
1960 -- Philadelphia Eagles 17, Green Bay Packers 13, at
Philadelphia
1961 -- Green Bay Packers 37, New York Giants 0, at Green Bay
1962 -- Green Bay Packers 16, New York Giants 7, at New York
1965 -- Green Bay Packers 23, Cleveland Browns 12, at Green
Bay
(beat the Dallas Cowboys in 1966 and 1967 in NFL title
game to reach the first two Super Bowls)
Super Bowls
1967 -- Green Bay Packers 35, Kansas City Chiefs 10, at Los
Angeles
1968 -- Green Bay Packers 33, Oakland Raiders 14, at Miami
1997 -- Green Bay Packers 35, New England Patriots 21, at New
Orleans
